clientIdHint: Public. It appears in the Spotify consent URL.
clientSecretHint: Stored encrypted and never shown back, so paste it again if you rotate it.
help: Song requests run on a Spotify app you own, so playback control and rate limits stay on your account. Create one, register the callback URL below on it, then paste its credentials here.
removeFailed: Could not remove the Spotify app.
removeWarning: Removing the app also disconnects the Spotify account, since the connection was issued by it. Song requests stop until you paste the client secret again and reconnect.
replaceReconnect: Switching to a different Spotify app? After you save, choose Reconnect Spotify. Your current connection was made through the old app.
saveFailed: Could not save the Spotify app.
savedReconnect: Spotify app saved. Choose Reconnect Spotify so song requests use the new app.
setHelp: Requests authorize against this Spotify app. The client secret is stored encrypted and never shown again.
stepPaste: Copy the app's Client ID and Client Secret into the fields below.
stepRedirect: Paste this exact Redirect URI into your app’s Redirect URIs field in Spotify, then save:
title: Your Spotify app
redirectCopyFailed: Could not copy. Select the URL and copy it manually.
label: Spotify app
